formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua/Water/Eau and Parfum/Fragrance one entry each; normalized one-based positions.
formulaBlock.e3ProminenceCutoff: Parfum/Fragrance listed last (28) -> positions 1-27 mechanically prominent (atypical ordering; recorded)

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic. Earliest cleansing surfactant Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate (2, mild anionic) with prominent glucoside Decyl Glucoside (3) and amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4) -> low.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate (18) is a minor anionic succinate co-surfactant/hydrotrope (assigned mild/not a strong route by chemistry); does not change C6.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Multiple complementary systems: prominent amino-silicone Amodimethicone (10), cationic Starch Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9), Hydrolyzed Collagen (7), modified-starch film (8), refatters Glyceryl Oleate (12), Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate (16), Lecithin (19), fatty acid Coconut Acid (17), humectant Urea (15). C2 reading: early silicone + cationic polymer + humectant (Urea) present; the pearlizing/fatty element rests on Coconut Acid (17), a fatty acid rather than a pearlizer or fatty alcohol.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: The fatty-route element is debatable (no pearlizer, no fatty alcohol); cationic is a starch, lighter than guar; amodimethicone after salt and proteins.

weightPotential.rationale: Amino-silicone plus cationic starch plus protein converge, and a mild sulfate-free chassis offers weak reset; no prominent payload lipid, so no W-RICH.

depositionLoad.rationale: Amodimethicone (10), Starch HPTC (9), Hydrolyzed Collagen (7), weak refatters (12, 16, 17, 19).

persistence.rationale: Amodimethicone deposits selectively and persists; starch cationic and refatters are light.

excluded: Sodium Lactate (13), Lactic Acid (14), Citric Acid (22): pH buffers
unresolved: Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate (8): amphiphilic anionic modified starch (emulsion stabilizer / light film); no cationic charge; judged not band-moving on its own, recorded rather than counted
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A plausibly persistent amino-silicone + cationic system with weak reset makes calling it light an understatement.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: no W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid), the cationic is a light starch polymer and the other routes are weak refatters/hydrolyzed protein; amodimethicone sits after salt. Not low: two persistent families converge against weak reset (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Weak reset plus converging silicone/cationic/protein routes leaves high a realistic neighbor; modified starch (8) role not fully resolved.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only candidate: repair (collagen + amodimethicone + cationic starch: a substantive damage-care cluster); biotin is not a route.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met mechanically: Urea (15) comfort + humectant, Sodium Lactate (13), Glyceryl Oleate (12) prominent because Parfum is listed last.

formulaFacts.role: fatty acid (refatter; contested C2 fatty element)
